analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 9 Oct 2026
key_insights: Markets are trading higher on 9 Oct 2026 as participants digest a headline-heavy prior session. Crude is marginally lower and rates are higher. Reduced anxiety in the AI space is supporting sentiment.
Momentum (GSCBHMOM Index) is up 2.6% today after falling 7.5% over the prior three sessions, a partial reversion.
DAL is down 1.5% after a headline EPS miss and a full-year guidance cut. The call noted resilient demand and an expectation that fuel prices normalize.
Managed care shows wide dispersion after Medicare STARS data: HUM is up 12.5% and ALHC is down 15.9%.
OpenAI said it is on track for $70bn of annualized revenue by year-end. That calmed some AI angst, and the GS tech desk has been a better seller of Semis and AI.
SPCX announced it acquired low band spectrum with the goal of becoming a major US mobile carrier. Telecom names saw continued supply: TMUS -12.8%, T -10.7%, VZ -10.7%.
GS Sector Specialists hold a US 3Q earnings preview at 2pm ET. About 7% of the SPX reports next week, with bank earnings starting Tuesday morning.
Liquidity is normalizing: ETF share of tape is 27% (-2% vs 20-day average) and top-of-book liquidity is above $11mm (+22% vs 20-day average).

GS franchise activity is 6 out of 10, with overall flows skewed 2% better to buy. Long-only clients are skewed 1.8% to buy (materials, macro products, health care). Hedge funds are skewed 2.4% to sell (materials, real estate, information technology).
Brazil local elections drove heavy volume. EWZ had its highest notional day in the fund's 25-year history on Monday at $8bn, and its largest volume week on record even before today's data.
